scope: Retrospective recovery of OSM elements cited in baseline desktop review notes. Each element is its OSM history version as of the end of the review day (America/New_York), capped at recovery start if that day is still in progress; way node coordinates are resolved at the same exclusive cutoff. This reproduces cited geometry; it does not re-review or strengthen the outcomes. Contributor names and UIDs omitted.
